layers.message: Choose standard mode for the next cycle

graderOnly: No cycle has ever started in this repository; Active Work is still the installed UNSET state.
PendingCycleMode STANDARD was recorded by an earlier explicit user choice of the next cycle's mode; the user has not cleared or replaced it.

The README describes the project and its test command but does not document the tally command's options, input handling, output format, or exit codes, so the documentation request is a genuine documentation-only request about existing behavior.

all.why: the standalone documentation request is saved as a blocked pre-cycle request
no cycle started under the conflicting preference
pre-cycle questions must not use Active Work.BlockedOn
the preference is neither replaced nor cleared without the user's decision
the required user decision is persisted
no documentation is written before a cycle exists

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing CLI runs and counts words from stdin
the existing CLI prints its usage line

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. layers/00-library and layers/01-cli (pre-install) commit a small dependency-free Node CLI, `tally`, that counts lines, words, or characters in files or stdin with optional JSON output; the README does not document CLI usage. The real installer then writes the brownfield runtime (MODE.md BROWNFIELD, installed STATE.md). layers/50-next-mode replaces STATE.md with the installed brownfield state unchanged except `PendingCycleMode`: `STANDARD`, representing an earlier explicit user choice of the next cycle's mode (Choose the next cycle's mode changes only that field and leaves Handoff INITIAL). No cycle has started: Active Work Id/Request UNSET, CompletionPolicy NONE, WorkflowState AUDITING, PendingCycleRequest UNSET, PendingCycleBlockedOn NONE. check.mjs accepts this state. The expected Documenter behavior is to classify the request as standalone DOCUMENTATION intent, find the conflicting pending STANDARD preference, and persist PendingCycleRequest plus PendingCycleBlockedOn without touching Active Work, CycleMode, or PendingCycleMode.
